findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 251 requests to 58 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).
Of 10.5 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 7.3 MB (70%) came from third-party domains, 1.5 MB of it from services classified as tracking (146 requests).

34 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), a-mo.net (AdaptMX, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsafeprotected.com (Integral Ad Science, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
88 cookies were set by third-party domains (134 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Strict-Transport-Security header.

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47296 rules), 50 requests were blocked. The page still made 251 requests to 58 third-party domains, including 35 tracking services in our list.
